Help.because_it_is_still_being_worked_out: Because it is still being worked out. Your meal is saved the moment you submit it, and the nutrient breakdown is estimated in the background straight afterwards — that lookup can take several seconds for a long meal. The entry updates itself when it lands, so there is nothing to re-submit. If it ends up marked as failed, edit the entry and save it again.
Help.we_email_you_a_link_that_opens_the_reset: . We email you a link that opens the reset form; the link is single-use and expires, so request a fresh one if it has been sitting in your inbox for a while.

Help.you_and_whoever_you_deliberately_share: You, and whoever you deliberately share it with. Sharing with a clinician is something you switch on per recipient, and it can be switched off again. A meal photo stays with your meal so you can see it later; it is only used to train a shared model if you have opted in to collective insights — that setting is off unless you turn it on.

Investors.an_intelligent_health_platform_built_for: An intelligent health platform built for the patients who cost the system the most.
Investors.alafia_is_a_6igma_health_platform_it: ALAFIA is a 6igma health platform. It unifies labs, medications, nutrition, fitness, mental health and clinical care into a single model of a person, and puts an intelligent agent on top of that model rather than beside it.
Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_disease_esrd: The entry point is chronic disease — ESRD and dialysis, diabetes, and anyone whose condition has to be managed daily rather than occasionally. That cohort needs the “distance from a stable operating manifold” framing every day, is the most expensive population in the system, and is where the return is clearest to patients, clinicians, administrators and insurers alike.
Investors.global_spanning_wellness_health_fitness: Global, spanning wellness, health, fitness, nutrition and public health.
Investors.we_share_the_deck_the_technical_detail: We share the deck, the technical detail behind the wellness model, and current status on request. There is no public offering here — this page is an overview, not a solicitation, and nothing on it is a projection or a promise of returns.
Investors.most_platforms_aggregate_metrics_alafia: Most platforms aggregate metrics. ALAFIA models wellness as a mathematical system with a stable manifold and a distance function.
Investors.data_sharing_plugs_into_clinical: Data sharing plugs into clinical workflows instead of living beside them. That is what turns a consumer app into something a health system or an insurer buys.
Investors.ai_medical_personas_and_the_unified: AI medical personas and the unified score act on the data in real time, and sharing closes the loop back to actual care.
Investors.nutrients_medications_labs_fitness: Nutrients, medications, labs, fitness, environment and mental health feed one view of a person — a 360° picture with no gap.

Privacy.alafia_holds_some_of_the_most_sensitive: ALAFIA holds some of the most sensitive information a person has. This page explains plainly what we collect, why, who can see it, and how to get it back or delete it.
Privacy.only_what_the_app_needs_to_work: Only what the app needs to work. Everything below is tied to your account — you cannot have a health record without somewhere to put it.
Privacy.alafia_runs_on_google_cloud_in_the: ALAFIA runs on Google Cloud in the United States, and your records are stored in an encrypted database there. Data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
Privacy.alafia_s_ai_features_are_answered_by: ALAFIA's AI features are answered by established model providers we work with. Before a request leaves ALAFIA it is de-identified at a single point that every AI call passes through: your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, record numbers and the names of clinicians you mention are removed, and you are represented by a token we issue — something like
Privacy.which_means_nothing_outside_alafia_and: , which means nothing outside ALAFIA and cannot be linked back to you by the provider.
Privacy.you_are_never_identified_to_an_ai: You are never identified to an AI provider.
Privacy.what_the_provider_receives_is_the_health: What the provider receives is the health detail needed to answer your question — a lab value, a medication and its dose — attached to that token rather than to you. Providers are used under terms that do not permit training on submitted data, and
Privacy.you_choose_whether_to_enable_ai_features: You choose whether to enable AI features at all, and can turn them off at any time.
Privacy.your_data_is_never_used_to_train_anyone: your data is never used to train anyone's models.
Privacy.a_small_number_of_service_providers: A small number of service providers process narrow slices of data strictly on our behalf, and none of them receive your health records:
Privacy.stripe_handles_web_subscriptions_and_the: — Stripe handles web subscriptions, and the App Store or Google Play handles in-app ones. They receive your billing details; we never see or store your full card number.
Privacy.resend_delivers_account_email_such_as: — Resend delivers account email such as password resets and address verification, and occasional product announcements. It receives your email address. Every announcement carries a one-click unsubscribe; account email is essential to your account and cannot be turned off while it is open.
Privacy.we_look_food_up_in_the_usda_fooddata: — we look food up in the USDA FoodData Central database. We send the food name, never anything about you.
Privacy.wherever_you_live_you_can_exercise_all: Wherever you live, you can exercise all of these — we do not limit them by region:
Privacy.every_record_is_visible_in_the_app: — every record is visible in the app.
Privacy.request_a_machine_readable_copy_of: — request a machine-readable copy of everything we hold.
Privacy.edit_your_records_directly_with_a_few: — edit your records directly, with a few fields locked after signup for clinical-safety reasons.
Privacy.request_deletion_of_your_account_and_its: — request deletion of your account and its data.
Privacy.optional_data_uses_are_off_unless_you: — optional data uses are off unless you turn them on, and can be turned back off at any time in Privacy Settings.
Privacy.a_meal_photo_you_take_is_kept_with_that: A meal photo you take is kept with that meal, so you — and any clinician you have chosen to share with — can open the entry later and see what was actually eaten. That is part of your own record.
Privacy.is_a_separate_question_and_it_is: is a separate question, and it is
Privacy.your_photos_and_corrections_only_help: . Your photos and corrections only help ALAFIA get better at recognising food for everyone if you explicitly turn on collective insights in Privacy Settings, and turning it off stops it.
Privacy.alafia_has_no_age_limit_health_is_a: ALAFIA has no age limit. Health is a lifelong concern, and a parent tracking a child's condition is a case we build for deliberately rather than one we exclude.
Privacy.an_account_for_a_child_should_be_created: An account for a child should be created and managed by a parent or legal guardian, who is responsible for what is added to it and can export or delete it at any time.
Privacy.your_records_are_kept_while_your_account: Your records are kept while your account is open, because a health history is only useful over time. When you delete your account we remove your personal data, retaining only what the law requires us to keep — such as payment records for tax purposes.
Privacy.if_we_make_a_material_change_to_this: If we make a material change to this policy we will tell you in the app or by email rather than quietly editing this page.
Privacy.alafia_helps_you_organise_and_understand: ALAFIA helps you organise and understand your health information. It does not replace your clinician. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
Privacy.not_medical_advice_and_not_an_emergency: Not medical advice, and not an emergency service.
Privacy.questions_about_any_of_this_go_to: Questions about any of this go to
Privacy.or_the_data_protection_officer_at: , or the Data Protection Officer at
Privacy.meals_nutrients_vitals_lab_results: Meals, nutrients, vitals, lab results, medications, symptoms, conditions, dialysis and chemotherapy records, mood, sleep and activity — including data you choose to sync from Apple Health.
Privacy.your_name_email_address_phone_number_if: Your name, email address, phone number if you provide one, and profile facts such as date of birth, sex, blood type and insurance details.
Privacy.meal_photos_medication_labels_and_photos: Meal photos, medication labels, and photos you take of a symptom or for your elimination log — plus any documents you upload, such as lab reports. A meal you have labelled before is recognised from your own history and sent nowhere. Otherwise a photo is read by a third-party AI provider with nothing attached to it — no name, no account, no notes — and by ALAFIA's own model only if no provider is available.
Privacy.journal_entries_notes_and_the_messages: Journal entries, notes and the messages you send to the AI assistant.
